name: Zep Vector Store
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Zep Vector Store to interact with Zep vector databases. You can insert documents into a vector database, get documents from a vector database, retrieve documents to provide them to a retriever connected to a chain[^1], or connect it directly to an agent[^2] to use as a tool[^3]
